title: Version and capability compatibility rules
description: Negotiation is data, not prose, because the failure mode is silent: an extension that sends commands an older Connector misreads can apply a wrong proxy configuration. The extension sends nothing until connector.hello succeeds. The `capabilities` array below is the single normative registry of capability names: protocol/commands/*.json may cite only names declared here, and the hello result recorded in protocol/fixtures/protocol/handshake.jsonl must announce exactly this set -- scripts/verify.mjs asserts equality in both directions, so a name can neither be added to the registry nor dropped from a hello without failing here.

negotiation.announcedByExtension: requiresProtocol (its own max supported protocol version and min acceptable connector version)
negotiation.rule: compatible iff extension.requiresProtocol.min <= connector.protocolVersion AND connector.minCompatibleProtocolVersion <= extension.protocolVersion; intersection empty => VersionMismatch
negotiation.onIncompatible: The Connector panel is disabled with an explicit reason. Legacy Omega profiles MUST keep working: a NEXORA entity that cannot be applied is a visible error, never a silently direct connection.

commandGating.rule: A command whose capabilities[] is non-empty MUST NOT be sent until hello reports every listed capability.
commandGating.enforcement: scripts/verify.mjs checks that every capability cited by a command exists in this file and is announced by the recorded hello, and that the hello set and this registry are the same set; Phase 2 tests assert the client refuses to send ungated commands.

capabilities.name: vless.tcp.tls.vision
capabilities.description: VLESS + TCP + TLS with xtls-rprx-vision flow.

capabilities.name: vless.grpc.tls
capabilities.description: VLESS over gRPC transport with TLS (multi-mode supported).

capabilities.name: vless.xhttp.tls
capabilities.description: VLESS over XHTTP (auto/str/packet-up modes) with TLS.

capabilities.name: vless.reality
capabilities.description: REALITY security: publicKey, shortId, spiderX, fingerprint.

capabilities.name: chunked.import
capabilities.description: envelope.chunk reassembly for payloads above the frame limit.

capabilities.name: health.probes
capabilities.description: Layered probes: dns / tcp / core-outbound / proxied-http. Required so the UI never presents a TCP result as a proxy verdict (master prompt 13).

capabilities.name: failure.block-loopback
capabilities.description: The fail-closed primitive: apply a FixedProfile on a closed loopback port.

capabilities.name: config.snapshot
capabilities.description: Hash of the applied config plus a masked config, for drift detection after reconnect.

capabilities.name: keystore.dpapi
capabilities.description: Windows DPAPI-backed keystore (ADR-0011). Absent on platforms where the keystore uses another backend.

capabilities.name: diagnostics.redacted
capabilities.description: diagnostics.get output is masked at the sink; a Connector without this capability cannot serve the Diagnostics panel at all.

capabilities.name: integrity.pinned-core
capabilities.description: Core binaries are validated against pins before execution; IntegrityMismatch refuses to start.

matrix.notes: Extension must send only commands and capabilities it declared support for; unknown event names are ignored, unknown response fields are tolerated.
Extension refuses commands the Connector cannot answer; legacy profiles and subscriptions continue to work.

stability.additive: New optional fields and new capability names are backward compatible.
stability.breaking: Removing a field, changing a type, or redefining a command's effect requires protocolVersion + 1 and a matrix row.
stability.errorCodes: The taxonomy is closed: adding a code is breaking for clients that switch exhaustively, so new codes are added only with a documented fallback.
